The farad (F) is the unit of capacitance.  
Capacitance \( C \) is defined as \( C = \frac{Q}{V} \), where \( Q \) is charge in coulombs (C) and \( V \) is voltage in volts (V).  
So 1 F = \( \frac{1\, \text{C}}{1\, \text{V}} \), which is the ratio of 1 coulomb to 1 volt.  

That matches option (C).  

Final answer: (C)
